rules.v: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
rules.vi: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
rules.n: Labour Law art. 7 excludes domestic workers; they are governed by the Domestic Workers Regulation (MD 40676/1445, published October 2023, in force 2024), which replaces MD 310/1434.
rules.s: Labour Law (M/51, 2005) art. 7; Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Contract on the ministry's mandatory templates; Arabic text prevails, with a translation into the worker's language; one year by default. The contract is valid even if not in writing, and no copy to the worker is required; Musaned registration is required by ministry procedure.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Monthly payment by ministry-approved methods, deductions capped at 25 per cent; digital-wallet payment compulsory for all domestic workers, phased in July 2024 to January 2026.
rules.s: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 arts 17-20; HRSD

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: At most 10 hours' work a day, at least 8 consecutive hours' rest and a break of at least 30 minutes after five hours; longer than the 8-hour norm under the Labour Law.

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja
rules.n: One paid rest day a week.
30 days' paid leave after every two years if the contract is renewed (the Labour Law gives 21 days a year).

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
rules.vi: Hak tegas, atau penahanan oleh pemberi kerja dilarang dengan sanksi
rules.n: The employer may not keep the worker's passport or personal documents.

rules.v: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
rules.vi: Hanya standar akomodasi; tinggal di rumah majikan dapat diwajibkan
rules.n: Suitable housing and food (or a cash allowance), and the right to contact family, embassy and authorities; no rule on privacy.

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: Transfer without the employer's consent in 12 listed cases (e.g. three unpaid wages, no residence permit, being hired out, dangerous work, abuse, employer's delay in a complaint); final exit at the end of the contract. No general right to change employer; the 2021 labour reforms exclude domestic workers.
rules.s: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 27; MD 212875/1443; HRSD rules on the contractual relationship (2024) art. 5(3)

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: The employer bears recruitment costs and fees; recruitment companies may not take any sum from the worker or receive payments outside the Musaned platform.
rules.s: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 15(1); Recruitment Rules, MD 119698 (2025) arts 42, 50

rules.v: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
rules.vi: Agen berizin dan bertanggung jawab kepada pekerja (pengembalian, biaya pulang atau tanggung renteng)
rules.n: Recruitment companies are licensed with bank guarantees (SAR 2-10 million by category) that the ministry may draw on for unpaid worker dues or return costs; the licensee is liable for the worker it placed and must house absent workers; replacement or refund during the 90-day probation.
rules.s: Recruitment Rules, MD 119698 (2025) arts 8, 13, 46, 49, 53, 59; Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445 art. 9

rules.n: The regulation gives no power to inspect households; enforcement is complaint-based.

rules.v: Administrative settlement only, or narrower access
rules.vi: Hanya penyelesaian administratif, atau akses lebih sempit
rules.n: Complaints to the ministry, which seeks an amicable settlement; claims lapse after 12 months.

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: 30 days' sick leave a year (15 at full pay, 15 at half pay); end-of-service award of one month's wage per four years; health insurance under the 2024 framework; no maternity leave.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.n: Violence, harassment, forced labour and trafficking prohibited; employer fines up to SAR 20,000 and/or a recruitment ban.

rules.vi: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
rules.n: No provision in the regulation; migrant workers may not join workers' committees.
rules.s: Domestic Workers Regulation, MD 40676/1445; CoM Decree 12/1422

decisions.nm: Workers’ wage claims against Saudi Oger
decisions.pe: Tens of thousands of workers of many nationalities at Saudi Oger went months without pay. Labour judgments in their favour were sent to the execution court, which ordered payment and moved to seize company assets.
decisions.pi: Puluhan ribu pekerja berbagai kebangsaan di Saudi Oger tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Putusan perburuhan yang memenangkan mereka dikirim ke pengadilan eksekusi, yang memerintahkan pembayaran dan mulai menyita aset perusahaan.

decisions.nm: Domestic worker’s claim for years of unpaid wages
decisions.pe: A Sri Lankan domestic worker said she had not been paid for over a decade. A court in Hail ordered the employer to pay her wages and her flight home.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga asal Sri Lanka mengaku tidak digaji lebih dari sepuluh tahun. Pengadilan di Hail memerintahkan majikan membayar upahnya dan tiket pulangnya.

decisions.nm: Staff wage claims against a contracting company owner
decisions.pe: Workers of a contracting company had not been paid for months. A labour court told the owner to pay them or face arrest.
decisions.pi: Pekerja sebuah perusahaan kontraktor tidak digaji berbulan-bulan. Pengadilan perburuhan memerintahkan pemiliknya membayar atau menghadapi penangkapan.

help.de: Labor complaints in six languages. Domestic workers can also complain through the Musaned platform.
help.di: Pengaduan ketenagakerjaan dalam enam bahasa. Pekerja rumah tangga juga bisa mengadu melalui platform Musaned.

help.de: Receives complaints about human rights violations, including against employers.
help.di: Menerima pengaduan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia, termasuk terhadap majikan.
